---
title: "Find the question. Run the solution."
---

Search by what you need to do: **calculate an average**, **identify an outlier**, **make a readable graph**, **estimate a probability**, or **interpret a statistical result**.

Each problem has numbered RStudio steps, an independently runnable R script, a plain-language interpretation, and a warning about what the result does *not* establish.

## Search from RStudio itself

```r
library(rulearn)
ru_find("histogram")
ru_plan("histogram", have=c("numeric", "units"), missing="groups")
ru_run("histogram")
```

[Browse the complete question bank](problems/index.qmd)

The question bank uses fictional practice measurements. Do not substitute example output for calculations using your own data.
